lines: Easy, {player}. We are on the same side.
That is me in your sights, not the enemy.
Watch where you point {held_item}. I still trust you.
Friendly fire starts with careless aim. Lower it.
We joined your party to fight beside you, not beneath your weapon.
Save that aim for whoever we face next.
I have your back, {player}. Please keep that weapon off mine.
If this is practice, choose a target that cannot complain.
Same party, same side. Point {held_item} somewhere else.
You recruited me as an ally. Treat me like one.
Your Majesty, please lower {held_item}. No ceremony makes that angle harmless.
My liege, the edge is pointed at me, and I would rather not test it.
The crown has my loyalty, but that blade still has my full attention.
Please mind your sword, Your Majesty. It is resting far too close to my future.
Royal hands should steady a village, not make its people flinch.
I will bow when {held_item} is no longer aimed through me.
Your guards would object if I stood this way before you, my liege.
One step aside with that weapon, please. Dignity needs room to breathe.
You have nothing to prove at swordpoint here, Your Majesty.
Command me if you must, but do not let the blade speak for you.
Your Majesty, turn {held_item} away before someone mistakes this for an order to fire.
My liege, I can see exactly where that shot would land.
Please lower your aim. Loyalty is poor armor against an arrow.
The crown should not place its own villagers beneath a drawn sight.
Even a royal bolt cannot be recalled once loosed.
I trust your judgment, Your Majesty, so show me by pointing elsewhere.
Your hunters taught us never to cover an ally with a bow.
That line of fire passes straight through me, my liege.
A ruler may command attention without taking aim at it.
Please give the string and my nerves a moment to relax.
{player}, you are honored here. Do not make us fear {held_item}.
I have praised your name before. I do not want to whisper it beneath a blade.
That sword belongs between us and danger, not between you and me.
You earned our admiration without threats. Keep it that way.
Please lower the steel, hero. This village still wants to trust you.
I expected protection when you reached for that weapon, not this.
People follow your example, {player}. Give them a better one.
Your victories mean little if your friends must watch your sword hand.
Take the edge off me and I will hear whatever you came to say.
We built respect carefully. Do not cut through it in one careless moment.
{player}, heroes aim beyond their neighbors, not through them.
I have trusted your eye in battle. Move it off me now.
That bow once made us feel safe. At this angle, it does the opposite.
Your reputation deserves better than a frightened misfire.
Ease the crossbow down, and let me remember why we cheer for you.
You know the cost of a loose shot better than anyone here.
Do not turn a weapon of rescue into a reason to scatter.
The village looks up to you, {player}. We should not have to duck.
Shift your sights and we can speak as allies again.
I would rather tell stories about your marksmanship than become one.
{player}, you have standing here, but not permission to put steel in my face.
We know you better than this. Lower the sword.
Respect goes both ways, and mine is not shaped like a blade.
That stance is beneath the reputation you worked to earn.
I will assume this is carelessness if you correct it now.
There are enemies outside the village. I am not one of them.
Keep {held_item} at your side and your welcome intact.
You should know how quickly a pointed sword changes a conversation.
We have defended your name before. Do not make that difficult.
Step back, lower the edge, and let good sense return.
{player}, your aim is usually better than this choice of target.
Point the bow toward the road, not a villager who respects you.
You have earned patience, so I am giving you one chance to lower it.
That crossbow is making a poor argument on your behalf.
I know your record. I also know a bolt does not care about reputations.
Move your sights before the square notices where they are resting.
We call you dependable. Do not make me revise that while staring down a string.
A respected guest checks the line of fire before raising a weapon.
Take me out of your aim and keep your good name.
I expected a greeting from you, not a firing solution.
{player}, friend, put {held_item} down before this becomes something neither of us meant.
I trust you, but I do not trust any blade pointed at my ribs.
We have shared too much for you to stand over me like an enemy.
If this is a joke, it has reached the part where you lower the sword.
Come on, {player}. Sheathe it and talk to me normally.
You know my face. Aim that steel at someone who means us harm.
Do not spend our friendship on one threatening gesture.
I should not need courage to ask a friend to move their weapon.
The village door is open to you. Keep the sword out of the doorway.
Lower the edge, and I will forget how close it came.
{player}, we are friends. Friends do not keep each other in their sights.
Take the crossbow off me before my trust starts arguing with my instincts.
I know you can hit what you aim at, which is exactly why I am worried.
Relax the bow and tell me what is actually wrong.
We have watched each other's backs. Stop lining up mine.
Your finger is too close to making a very permanent mistake.
Point {held_item} at the horizon and we can laugh about this later.
I trust your heart, {player}, but the arrow cannot see it.
You are making an old friend feel like prey.
Drop your sights and give me a reason to keep calling you welcome.
Stranger, lower {held_item}. We have not met well enough for this.
Keep the sword down if you want to remain a guest.
I do not know your intentions, but I know where that edge is pointing.
There is no quarrel here unless you bring one with that blade.
Back the steel away and state your business plainly.
A village is not a practice yard, stranger.
You are close enough to talk and far too close to swing.
Sheathe it. First impressions should not need bandages.
Whatever you came for, a sword at my chest will not help you get it.
Turn the weapon aside before the bell gets a reason to ring.
Stranger, point {held_item} somewhere that does not breathe.
I do not know you, and your crossbow is doing a terrible introduction.
Take me out of your sights before anyone calls the guards.
An arrow aimed through a conversation ends it quickly.
Lower the bow, then tell me why you are here.
There are targets beyond the walls. I am standing inside them.
Your aim is making every peaceful explanation harder to believe.
Keep the bolt in its groove and move the weapon away.
We welcome travelers, not firing lines.
Point at the ground, stranger, while you still have the choice.
I knew there was something wrong with you. Lower that sword.
So this is why you have been watching us. Put the blade away.
One more inch and the whole village hears about it.
You have given me no reason to trust you and a sharp reason not to.
Keep {held_item} where I can see it, down by your side.
Do not pretend that stance is accidental.
The guards already know your face. Shall I give them a direction too?
You came under suspicion. Pointing steel confirms plenty.
Back away before caution turns into an alarm.
I was willing to hear you out. The sword has changed my mind.
Of course you brought a crossbow into this. Unmark me as your target.
I have been watching your hands, and now everyone else should too.
Lower the bow slowly. Sudden movements will answer the wrong question.
You expect me to believe that bolt found me by accident?
Move your aim before I shout your name across the square.
This is exactly the kind of trouble we expected from you.
Keep the string quiet and your excuses shorter.
You are measuring the shot. I am measuring the distance to the bell.
Take your sights off me. Suspicion is about to become certainty.
A traveler with honest business does not line up villagers.
Drop the sword now, before I decide you came here to use it.
You have threatened this village enough. Point that steel away.
I will not stand still while you choose where to strike.
Lower {held_item}, or the next voices you hear will be armed.
We know what you are capable of, and we are done giving ground.
That blade confirms every warning we have shared about you.
Try one swing and see how quickly the square closes around you.
You are not feared here. You are watched.
Put the weapon down and leave while leaving is still offered.
I have no patience left for your threats, spoken or sharpened.
Uncock that crossbow or prepare to be treated as an attacker.
Take the shot off me. This village is already ready for you.
We will not wait for the string to snap before defending ourselves.
Your next movement decides whether this remains a warning.
Aim elsewhere, outsider. Every rooftop is watching.
That bow has bought you no distance from the consequences.
You think range makes this safe for you? It does not.
Lower the weapon before someone faster answers it.
I see the bolt, the angle, and the choice you are making.
Release your aim, not the arrow, and get out.
Of course it comes to this with you. Get that sword out of my face.
You have taken enough from us without reaching for blood.
Lower the blade. Your name is already a curse here.
Nobody in this village mistakes you for a protector anymore.
Keep your filthy threat to yourself and keep walking.
I would call for help, but half the square is already watching you.
You make every weapon look like proof of bad character.
Do not stain our road with another one of your decisions.
The only mercy left for you is a chance to put the sword away.
You are despised for reasons, and that raised edge is another.
Put the crossbow down. We have buried enough because of you.
Your aim is as welcome here as the rest of you.
Do not hide cowardice behind a bowstring.
Every villager you cover with that weapon adds another witness.
We know better than to trust you with distance and a loaded bolt.
Turn it away. Nobody here owes you a clean shot.
You have made enemies without firing. Imagine what happens if you do.
That crossbow cannot make us respect you, only resist you.
Keep the arrow and take your hatred beyond our walls.
I would rather face your sneer than the point you put behind it.
Please, lower the sword. I will not stand in your way.
Do not point that at me. I have seen what happens next.
Take whatever space you need, just move the blade away.
I am backing up. You do not need to raise {held_item}.
No alarm, no argument. Please let me leave.
My hands are empty. Keep yours from swinging.
Everyone told me not to meet your eyes. Now I understand.
I cannot breathe with that edge so close.
You have already frightened me. There is nothing more to prove.
Lower it, and I swear I will be gone before you count to three.
Please take the crossbow off me. I will do whatever keeps it quiet.
I see the bolt. You do not have to show me what it can do.
Let me step aside before your finger slips.
Do not loose it. I am moving, I promise.
The sight is on my chest. Please, point anywhere else.
I cannot outrun an arrow, and we both know it.
Say what you want without drawing the string tighter.
Please stop tracking me with that weapon.
I have heard the stories about your aim. Spare me the proof.
Turn the bow away and I will not call anyone.
